links.plain: front intention manager powering down the moment an external save is trusted
links.function: reduces lateral rostral prefrontal maintenance effort once an external reminder or folder takes responsibility
links.narration_bridge: Directly observed in human fMRI by Landsiedel & Gilbert (2015, NeuroImage, SRC4).

links.plain: spatial pointer map keeping track of which folder or shelf holds the saved item
links.function: maintains external spatial/contextual lookup cues ('where to find it') under shifting cognitive load
links.narration_bridge: Aligns with Sparrow et al.'s (2011, SRC1) superior folder-location recall and Ozcelik's (2025, SRC3) fMRI load mapping.

links.plain: deep memory archivist skipping rich detail encoding on hasty point-and-shoot clicks
links.function: curtails deep episodic feature binding when attention disengages immediately at the shutter click, yet re-engages when zooming in
links.narration_bridge: Explains Henkel's (2014, Psychological Science, SRC2) museum photo impairment vs zoom rescue and Storm & Stone's (2015, SRC5) freed bandwidth.
